read.speaker: Weathered Plaque
read.text: Deep gouges in ancient stone, half-legible: "...sealed by Karneth's own hand, that what waits below might wait forever. Let no warden's watch be relieved."
read.text_zh: 古老石碑上刻著深深的紋路，字跡已半數難辨：「……由卡奈斯親手封印，願深處所待之物永世沉眠。守衛之責，永不解除。」

cont.speaker: Weathered Plaque
cont.text: Whatever came after that line is lost — the stone below it has crumbled away entirely.
cont.text_zh: 這句話之後的內容已經佚失——底下的石面早已完全崩落。
